marie: Quick sync for SOC2 lane — owners please confirm status for: audit-log backfill, KMS attestation, HSM smoke test, and any outstanding PRs/blockers. Can we get short ETAs by EOD? @ian @kyle @suresh
ian: I own audit-log backfill. Working on mapping legacy fields to new schema, hit a couple of malformed events. PR #482 is up for review (parser + tests). ETA Wed EOD if no more surprises.
kyle: KMS attestation in progress. Vendor needs cert chain and test vector; filed INF-237 for cert delivery. Waiting on infra to approve the ticket — no functional blocker on our side. ETA Fri.
suresh: HSM smoke tests — I have the test harness ready, just need staging access. @alyssa can you confirm staging HSM creds rotation window?
alyssa: Staging rotation window is Tue 00:00-02:00 UTC. We can do a short maintenance slot then; will slack the runbook beforehand.
ian: FYI the malformed events look like this: ```2026-03-10T18:12:05Z audit serviceX ERROR payload_missing: {"user": null}``` Quick patch in parser to skip null user fields — linked in PR.
marie: Good — flagged owners for the milestone doc. @ian after you merge, can you kick the backfill job and post the job id here? We need evidence for the fieldwork.
ian: will do. backfill job command: `./scripts/backfill_audit.sh --from 2026-01-01 --to 2026-03-01` I will post job id once started.
audit-bot: evidence-uploaded: soc2/evidence/audit-backfill/2026-03-16.tar.gz (size: 74MB) :white_check_mark:
marie: thanks @audit-bot — please add a short README in that bundle indicating which log ranges were included.
kyle: small ask — the attestation doc needs the KMS key IDs (not just alias). I'll add them to the ticket INF-237 later today.
suresh: once staging creds are confirmed, I'll run HSM smoke tests in the Tue window and post results. If anything fails I'll open an incident draft in #incidents.
alyssa: ping me if you need extended window. Also reminder: rotation will rotate test keys, not prod.
marie: Summary — owners assigned: audit-log backfill (ian) ETA Wed, KMS attestation (kyle) ETA Fri pending INF-237, HSM smoke (suresh) scheduled Tue window. Action items: i) @ian merge PR #482 + post job id + attach evidence README, ii) @kyle update INF-237 with key IDs and vendor certs path, iii) @suresh run smoke and post results. I'll consolidate into the milestone doc after EOD. Any blockers?
kyle: none from my side other than cert delivery timing.
ian: small risk if parser finds more legacy variants, will call it out here.
suresh: no blockers besides staging creds.
marie: perfect — we'll reconvene async here. If anything slips, mention the milestone tag so I can update the tracker.
